summary: Explains how to assign concessions to students, including selecting concession groups, setting amounts (percentage or fixed), adding mandatory remarks, and optionally uploading supporting documents.
steps: In the student's fee collection section, click the 'Concession' option.
If a predefined concession group (e.g., Sports Concession) is selected, the system automatically calculates the concession amount (e.g., 10% on tuition fee).
If 'Manual' is selected, enter the fixed concession amount.
Enter a mandatory remark explaining the reason for the concession.
Optionally, upload supporting documents (e.g., principal's application signature, approval letter).
The payable amount will be automatically updated to reflect the concession.
business_rules: Concession groups can be defined as percentage-based (e.g., 10% on tuition fee) or fixed amounts.
Remarks are mandatory when assigning a concession.
Document upload is optional but recommended for audit trails.
important_notes: Concession groups and their criteria (e.g., percentage, applicable fee heads) need to be shared and configured in the system.
The system can automatically calculate percentage-based concessions on specific fee heads once configured.
The updated payable amount is immediately visible after assigning the concession.
